findings.claim: 743B versus 753B GLM accounting remained unexplained and catalog total_b omitted stored MTP.
findings.evidence: Pinned official metadata reports 753,329,940,480. Five BF16 metadata headers cover all 791 layer78 tensors and sum 9,952,920,576. Difference is 743,377,019,904.
findings.resolution: Preserve approximate743B main/39B active headline, add explicit 753.33B full checkpoint scope; total_b=753.32994048, main_b=743.377019904, mtp_b=9.952920576.
findings.scope: Named-tensor and Hub metadata accounting; not independent unique training-parameter verification or tied/shared-weight deduplication.

findings.claim: GLM SGLang baseline incorrectly used glm45 tool parser.
findings.evidence: Official cookbook states auto tools resolves to glm47 and glm45 does not parse new tool-call format; reason parser remains glm45.
findings.resolution: Serving report corrected. Root must change --tool-call-parser to glm47 in profile and catalog copy.

findings.claim: Exact RedHat Flash precision contract was left unaudited.
findings.evidence: Pinned compressed-tensors config targets main routed experts layers3–44 with NVFP4 W4A4 and MTP expert layer45 with FP8 W8A8; exclusions govern remaining modules.
findings.resolution: Replaced unresolved statements across all Flash reports; exact revision and serialization bytes recorded.

findings.claim: GLM NVFP4 scope could incorrectly include MTP.
findings.evidence: RedHat ignores ^model.layers.78.*; Inferact explicitly excludes its MTP expert module.
findings.resolution: Both variants now explicitly described as main routed-expert NVFP4 with MTP excluded.

findings.claim: All seven Z.ai-related variant revisions were null and BF16 variants only indirectly evidenced.
findings.evidence: Direct pinned Hub API, model cards and config/index retrievals succeeded for every named variant.
findings.resolution: All revisions resolved; no GPU claims added.

findings.claim: Flash 320B headline was also used as exact checkpoint count.
findings.evidence: Publisher headline320B/18B; both official API variants report321,323,031,390 parameters.
findings.resolution: Keep rounded publisher headline, use total_b=321.32303139 for checkpoint arithmetic and publisher_total_b=320.

findings.evidence: Pinned official LICENSE says MIT; BF16 license matches; RedHat card declaresMIT.
findings.resolution: Record MIT identification without claiming broader legal clearance.

findings.claim: GLM recipe MTP depth called a measured starting hypothesis.
findings.evidence: Recipe documents five proposals; no local B300 measurement exists.
findings.resolution: Replaced measured wording with documented candidate.

findings.claim: Flash disaggregation and speculation could be read as freely composable experiments.
findings.evidence: SGLang current PD documentation: dummy-weight mechanical checks only; speculation does not start; keep sameTP; real-weight accuracy/load qualification missing.
findings.resolution: Explicit separate PD preview boundary in Flash serving and validation; vLLM matching-state-layout requirement kept separately.

findings.claim: Memory/precision arithmetic lacked actual serialization metadata and state exclusions.
findings.evidence: All seven indices inspected; Flash state34×64×128×128×4=142,606,336bytes=136MiB; RedHatFlash tensor payload reduction39.75%, not50% for entire artifact.
findings.resolution: Added exact index totals and exclusion scopes; no index byte count labeled measured resident memory.

findings.claim: MTP expanded as next-token prediction and Flash data flow attributed target verification to MTP.
findings.resolution: Corrected to multi-token prediction and serving-engine target verification/state commit.

findings.claim: Engine recipe minimum versions and runtime switches are not uniformly reliable.
